name: Master of Possession

bonuses.name: Architect of Ruin
bonuses.text: The GM gains 1 point of Ruin at the start of each of this Threat's turns.

bonuses.name: Champion
bonuses.text: This Threat may use Ruin Actions and has 2 personal Ruin.

bonuses.name: Mark of Chaos
bonuses.text: This Threat has a Mark of Chaos (W&G p.136)

bonuses.name: Space Marine Implants
bonuses.text: Gain bonus dice and options for actions from Space Marine Implants (W&G p.75)

bonuses.name: Warp Touched
bonuses.text: Whenever a Master of Possession rolls a Psychic Mastery (Wil) Test, they gain bonus Wrath dice equal to the Tier of the game.

abilities.name: Maleficarum
abilities.text: The Master of Possession attempts to activate Smite or a Maleficarum psychic power (W&G p.280).

abilities.name: Slaughter of the Gods
abilities.text: The Master of Possession uses their sacrificial dagger to slay a friendly non-daemonic Heretic Astartes within 6m. Doing so provides the Master of Possession a bonus 2 dice to their next Psychic Mastery (Wil) test.

abilities.name: Soulbane
abilities.text: When this Threat makes a Critical Hit against a target with the PSYKER keyword, when attack with a Staff of Possession, they target suffers 1d3 Mortal Wounds in additional to the Critical Hit's effects.

abilities.name: Psychic Storm
abilities.text: Spend 1 Ruin. The Master of Possession attempts to activate a psychic power or Deny the Witch (W&G p.267).

abilities.name: Whispers of the Warp
abilities.text: Spend 1 Ruin. Target PSYKER within 20m of this Threat adds +10 to their Perils of the Warp result.

note: Print errors copied as printed in Soulbane: 'when attack with', 'they target suffers', 'in additional to'.
